Riley (People Ops): FYI: All-hands Thu 10am PT (HQ + Zoom). Short agenda below; please drop Qs here or use the anon form: https://forms.redwood.internal/ah-qna.

Riley (People Ops): Agenda (20m):
• 6m — Exec update & company metrics (Zoe)
• 6m — Playbook launch + success criteria (Omar)
• 4m — Runtime perf wins + rollout plan (Sana)
• 2m — Security note: small retention tweak (Ivy)
• 2m — Quick GTM mention + partner callout
• 0-?m — Rapid Q&A

Riley (People Ops): Asks: upload slides to drive.redwood.internal/allhands/thu-2026 by Wed 3pm. If you demo, post 1-line blurb + infra needs.

Zoe (CEO): I'll open with runway snapshot and one ask for managers: flag any cross-team blockers.

Omar (Product): We'll present the launch checklist and two success KPIs. Will post playbook link during the call.

Sana (Eng): Eng will show a short clip of the prefetch improvement (internal bench: ~12% p99). Need co-host rights.

Ivy (Security): Quick note: retention change affects internal debug logs only; no change to customer defaults. I'll share the scoped doc in my slot.

Calendar Bot: Event updated: "All-Hands — Playbook Launch & Ops" Thu 10:00 PT — Zoom link pinned.

Riley (People Ops): Recording + captions will be posted within 24h to #all-hands-recordings. DM me if you want clips. Please confirm slide upload here once done.
